title: The bell list's 3-day limit and its 50-alert cap are never tested
what: No database test puts a 4-day-old alert or more than 50 alerts in a gym and checks what the bell list returns. The only date check asks for alerts newer than now, so the 3-day window and the cap could break unseen.
expected: A test with alerts from 4 days ago and today, and 51 recent ones, checks only the last 3 days come back, newest first, at most 50.
fix_line: Add old and over-50 alerts to the alerts database test and check the list

title: The 30-day clean-up of old alerts is never tested
what: Old alerts are deleted at random, about once in 100 writes. No test checks that alerts older than 30 days go, or that the new alert written at that moment is kept.
expected: A test forces the clean-up and checks old alerts are gone and the new one is saved.
fix_line: Add a clean-up check that does not depend on chance

title: No test proves a member's action still saves when its alert fails
what: The tests only call the alert writer alone with a bad line. They never make the alert fail inside a real shop order, complaint, check-in number, question or join and check the member's action is still saved.
expected: For at least one real member action, a test makes the alert write fail and checks the order or message is still kept.
fix_line: Add a test where the alert fails during a real member action

title: The page a real alert opens is never checked for shop, check-in, plan and trainer-question alerts
what: For a real shop order, check-in number, plan request and a question sent to one trainer, the tests check the line or the urgent flag but not the page the alert opens. The check-in alert's words from a real member are never checked at all; tests only type that line by hand.
expected: Each real member action is tested for its exact line and its page (Shop, Today, Member messages).
fix_line: Check the line and page of each real alert in the alerts test

title: The online-payment alert call's count and its 100-item limit are never tested
what: The database test never reads the answer of the payment alert call, and never hands it more than 100 items. The Worker test only uses a pretend answer.
expected: A test checks the answer counts the alerts written and that only 100 items are handled in one call.
fix_line: Read the call's answer and send 101 items in the alerts test

title: Removing or giving back the trainer tick is never tested on the bell
what: Tests check that a person without the trainer tick never sees question alerts, but never remove the tick from a trainer who already has a question in the bell, and never give it back.
expected: A test removes a trainer's tick and checks the question alert leaves the bell while other alerts stay, then gives it back and checks the alert returns.
how_often: whenever an owner changes a trainer
fix_line: Add the untick and re-tick steps to the alerts test

title: No test checks a plan request that is no longer waiting makes no alert
what: The plan request tests only write new waiting requests. No test checks that a request already approved or refused gets no alert.
expected: A test writes a request that is not waiting and checks no alert is made.
fix_line: Add a not-waiting request to the alerts test
